entities.summary: Vyacheslav Buravchikov is a Russian former professional ice hockey defenceman. He played for HC Atlant Moscow, Ak Bars Kazan and HC CSKA Moscow. He was drafted 191st overall in the 2005 NHL Entry Draft by the Buffalo Sabres of the National Hockey League (NHL).
